metadata.description: Deep static code review of a change set (Git or SVN) that produces one structured, evidence-backed report with severity-graded findings, a conclusion, and a prioritized todo list. Language-agnostic rules stay separate from pluggable per-language packs; supports full and single-category review modes.

plugins.name: oh-my-codereview
plugins.description: Evidence-bound static code review. Pin the reviewed revision, map the change set, apply language-agnostic rules plus pluggable language packs, and deliver a single validated report with severity-graded findings, a conclusion, and a prioritized todo list. Diff-first; full and single-category modes.
